thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/18/2018: ERIC, SAP, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/18/2018: ERIC, SAP, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.10%
AAPL: -0.88%
IBM: -0.40%
CSCO: +0.72%
GOOG: +0.03%
Technology stocks were mostly lower pre-bell Thursday.
Early movers include:
(+) Ericsson ( ERIC ), which was more than 4% higher after it posted Q3 adjusted net profit of SEK1.03 ($0.11) per diluted share compared with a net loss of SEK0.29 per diluted share in the year-ago period.
(-) SAP ( SAP ) was declining more than 3% after it raised the outlook for its full year results amid a jump in third quarter revenue, which was supported by growth in its cloud and software offerings.
